statement: The world-readable credential store was fixed (chmod 600) and closed durably rather than patched once: UMask=0077 was added to all four systemd units (9router, openmt-registry, openmt-backup, openclaw-gateway), all four restarted live, and all 7 Discord bots verified reconnected cleanly afterward including a real CoreBot round-trip.
subject: self

statement: The credential-permission incident produced a durable code change, not just a one-time fix: registry/db.js's openDb() now self-heals permissions to 600 on every daemon start regardless of what created the file, and backup.js explicitly writes its DB snapshot at 600 rather than relying on inherited/umask-derived permissions.
subject: self

statement: Because job_id labels are not unique, db.js's findJobByLabel (backing '/usage job <id>', '/history <id>', and '/retry <id>') resolves an ambiguous label to whichever matching job has the highest internal row id — silently returning a different, unrelated job's cost/history/retry data if an older same-labeled job is queried, rather than reporting the ambiguity.
